fred_macro_latest_vintage.limitation: Latest revised vintage; not point-in-time historical data. Weekly series require release-lag treatment.
fred_macro_latest_vintage.provider: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED

release_lag.note: Latest-vintage observations inherit the immutable snapshot retrieval timestamp; ref_date plus a nominal publication lag would falsely predate later revisions.

fred_macro_latest_vintage.reviewed_note: Structural-zero semantics have not yet been reviewed against the FRED series definitions; the empty declaration is not a finding.

nyfed_sofr.limitation: Publication occurs after the effective date; targets and features must respect that lag.
nyfed_sofr.provider: Federal Reserve Bank of New York

release_lag.note: SOFR is first published at about 08:00 ET on the next business day and may be revised at about 14:30 ET that day; 15:00 ET is the conservative finalized availability time.

nyfed_sofr.reviewed_note: Structural-zero semantics have not yet been reviewed against the New York Fed response schema; the empty declaration is not a finding.

sec_nmfp.limitation: As-filed data may contain reporting errors and becomes available after month-end.

release_lag.note: The bulk extract is a monthly compilation of as-filed submissions; rows inherit the immutable extract retrieval timestamp rather than the filing deadline or report date.

sec_nmfp.reviewed_note: Structural-zero semantics have not yet been reviewed across the Form N-MFP tables and filing variants; the empty declaration is not a finding.

treasury_auctions.limitation: Announcement and result vintages must be separated to avoid using auction outcomes too early.
treasury_auctions.provider: U.S. Department of the Treasury Fiscal Data

release_lag.note: Fiscal Data defines record_date as the publication date; end-of-day availability conservatively avoids assuming an intraday publication time.

treasury_auctions.reviewed_note: Structural-zero semantics have not yet been reviewed against the Treasury auction data dictionary; the empty declaration is not a finding.
